title: Aeronautics
description: Traits shared by every widget of anywidget-instruments-aeronautics, on top of those of the core (API-001 .. API-004, ROB-001).

mode.description: Every widget is an indicator; nothing is operated in flight (API-002).

theme.description: "night": a dark theme of lowered luminance (API-004); the others as in the core.

max_age.description: Seconds after which a value not updated is shown as stale; 0: never (ROB-001).

_value_seq.description: Incremented by the host at every update, even an unchanged one: max_age counts from the last update (ROB-001).
